name: install_cran
title: Attempts to install a package from CRAN.

origin.description: Install packages from a CRAN-like repository with install.packages.
origin.usage: install_cran(pkgs, repos = getOption("repos"), type = getOption("pkgType"), dependencies = NA, upgrade = c("default", "ask", "always", "never"), quiet = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: pkgs
arguments.text: Package names. One string is one package.

arguments.name: repos
arguments.text: Repository root. A file:// directory with src/contrib/PACKAGES is a CRAN-like repository.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Package type passed to install.packages. source installs a source tarball.

arguments.name: dependencies
arguments.text: Passed to install.packages. FALSE does not install dependencies.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: A cran remote is installed by utils::install.packages, not by downloading the tarball in remotes. The call prints how many packages are being installed.
origin.value: The package name, or a character vector of names.
origin.example: install_cran("minipkg", repos = repos, type = "source", dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Install packages from a CRAN-like repository by calling R's install.packages.
translation.usage: install_cran(pkgs, repos=None, type='source', dependencies=NA, upgrade='default', quiet=False, lib=None)

arguments.name: pkgs
arguments.text: A package name or a list of names.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Passed through to install.packages. The check uses source.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: The translation runs Rscript -e utils::install.packages with the same lib, repos, and type. No extra Python package is used.
translation.example: install_cran("minipkg", repos=repos, type="source", dependencies=False, upgrade="never", quiet=True, lib=lib)
